data.title: Constructing Angles of Various Sizes
data.description: Practice drawing and constructing angles between specific given measures using interactive rays.

challenges.narration: A laptop lid lifts from the keyboard.
challenges.instruction: Make an angle that is bigger than a right angle but smaller than a straight angle.
challenges.hint: Turn the purple ray and watch how wide the opening gets.
